notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Darigaaz's Attendant.
description:
Cast Wild Dogs either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Darigaaz's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Wild Dogs by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {B}{R}{G}.
If you cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.
